courses.title: Software Systems
courses.description: An introduction to programming and software construction. Imperative and object-oriented programming in Java, program decomposition, unit testing, and a first look at how a software system is designed and built by a team. Includes a project in which a working application is delivered.
learning_outcomes: Test and document a small software system

courses.title: Algorithms and Data Structures
courses.description: Fundamental data structures such as lists, trees, heaps, hash tables and graphs, together with the algorithms that operate on them. Algorithm design paradigms including divide and conquer, greedy methods and dynamic programming. Analysis of running time and correctness proofs.
learning_outcomes: Select and implement suitable data structures
Prove correctness and derive the complexity of algorithms

courses.title: Data and Information
courses.description: Storing and querying structured data. Conceptual modelling, the relational model, relational algebra, SQL, schema design and normal forms. Transactions, concurrency control and physical storage. A project in which an information system is modelled and implemented.
learning_outcomes: Model a domain and derive a normalised relational schema

courses.title: Computer Systems
courses.description: How a computer executes programs, from the instruction set architecture upwards. Memory hierarchy and caching, concurrency, processes and threads, scheduling, and the services an operating system provides. Practical assignments in C on a Unix-like system.
learning_outcomes: Explain the memory hierarchy and its effect on performance
Write concurrent programs using processes and threads

courses.title: Network Systems
courses.description: The architecture of computer networks and the internet. Protocol layering, link and network layers, routing, reliable transport and congestion control, application layer protocols, and an introduction to network security and distributed systems.
learning_outcomes: Analyse protocol behaviour at each layer

courses.title: Theory of Computation
courses.description: Models of computation and the languages they recognise. Finite state machines and regular expressions, context-free grammars and parsing, Turing machines, computability and undecidable problems, and an introduction to complexity classes.
learning_outcomes: Construct machines and grammars for formal languages
Classify problems as decidable or undecidable

courses.title: Intelligent Interaction Design
courses.description: Designing systems that reason and learn. Search and planning, probabilistic reasoning, supervised machine learning and evaluation methodology, combined with human-centred design and usability evaluation of the resulting system.
learning_outcomes: Apply search and learning techniques to a design problem

courses.title: Web Science
courses.description: The web as an engineered and social system. Web application architecture, client and server technologies, REST services, information retrieval and search engines, link analysis, and the analysis of large web data sets.
learning_outcomes: Build and deploy a web application with a REST back end
Explain how a search engine ranks documents

courses.title: Software Design and Engineering Project
courses.description: A large team project covering the full engineering lifecycle: requirements elicitation with a real client, architectural design, implementation with version control and continuous integration, systematic testing, and delivery with documentation.
learning_outcomes: Manage requirements and architecture for a realistic system
Deliver working software as a team
